notes: Set any pin, task or event to a radius from 5 to 5,000 meters. A 5 m alarm waits for fresh GPS accuracy of ±5 m or better. Each-visit entry alarms rearm at twice their radius (10 m for a 5 m pin), so small nearby areas can be used without walking 30 m away. Small exit zones now observe a useful inner area before ringing on departure. The editor explains the accuracy requirement and the limits of GPS around a house and parked car. GPS estimates proximity; it cannot reliably detect getting inside a vehicle. Preserves saved reminders and includes live GPS accuracy and updates in Settings.
